s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive facial asymmetry with skin thickening and subcutaneous enlargement
salient_findings: Progressive skin thickening and subcutaneous enlargement of the right side of the nose and cheek
Slightly hyperplastic soft tissue with dilated patulous follicles
key_facts: 10-year history of progressive symptoms
Multiple nondiagnostic skin biopsies
Septorhinoplasty 6 months prior due to collapse of the right nasal ala
Significant submucosal tissue was noted and removed from the right nasal cavity during surgery
Initial improvement after surgery, followed by enlargement of soft tissue and thickening of the overlying skin
Clinical examination revealed hyperplastic soft tissue and dilated patulous follicles
Surgical pathology showed fibroadipose tissue and vascular proliferation
Skin biopsy was interpreted as sebaceous hyperplasia
Surgical specimens revealed subcutaneous-based proliferation of spindle cells with varying density
Thickened and fragmented collagen bundles were observed
Mature adipocytes extended into skeletal tissue

shortlist.label: Fibrolipomatous hamartoma
shortlist.why_kept: Subcutaneous-based proliferation of spindle cells with varying density and mature adipocytes extending into skeletal tissue

shortlist.label: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive skin thickening and subcutaneous enlargement with hyperplastic soft tissue and dilated patulous follicles

shortlist.label: Lipomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Mature adipocytes extending into skeletal tissue and subcutaneous enlargement

shortlist.label: Nuchal-type fibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Thickened and fragmented collagen bundles and subcutaneous-based proliferation of spindle cells

shortlist.label: Angiolipoma
shortlist.why_kept: Vascular proliferation and fibroadipose tissue in surgical pathology

raw.rationale: The presence of subcutaneous-based proliferation of spindle cells with varying density, thickened and fragmented collagen bundles, and mature adipocytes extending into skeletal tissue are characteristic features of fibrolipomatous hamartoma, which best explains the key facts without contradiction.

rejected.label: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
rejected.why: Typically shows a more uniform storiform or cartwheel pattern of spindle cells and lacks the distinctive mixture of mature adipocytes and spindle cells seen in this case

rejected.label: Lipomatosis
rejected.why: Usually presents as multiple discrete lipomas rather than a single progressive lesion with subcutaneous and skeletal involvement

rejected.label: Nuchal-type fibroma
rejected.why: Characterized by a distinct nuchal location and a different histological pattern, lacking the prominent adipocytic component

rejected.label: Angiolipoma
rejected.why: Typically presents as a well-circumscribed, painful subcutaneous nodule with a prominent vascular component, which is not the primary feature in this case
